sources.title: Lampranthus falcatus
sources.clean: Lampranthus falcatus, commonly known as the sickle brightfig, is a succulent belonging to the genus Lampranthus. The species is endemic to the Western Cape and forms part of the fynbos. It occurs from Tulbagh to Worcester and the Langeberg.
